name: Stuffed Pita Pockets
description: A refreshing appetizer featuring mini pita pockets filled with a creamy ranch and feta cheese mixture, topped with cucumbers and tomatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the softened cream cheese, mayonnaise, and powdered ranch dressing mix until well combined.
Crumble feta cheese into the cream cheese mixture and stir to combine.
Cut the mini pita pockets in half and fill with the cheese mixture.
Top with diced cucumbers and tomatoes.
Serve and enjoy.

keywords: pita pockets, ranch dip, feta cheese, appetizer

_similar.name: Cheese English Muffins
_similar.description: Toasted English muffin quarters topped with a rich cheese and bacon mixture.
recipeIngredient: ½ lb sharp yellow cheese, grated

recipeInstructions.text: Mix grated cheese, mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, crumbled bacon, and chopped onion together.
Slice English muffins into quarters.
Spread the cheese mixture onto the English muffin quarters.
Bake at 400°F for 10 minutes.

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.keywords: pasta salad, feta cheese, herb dressing, vegetable salad

_similar.name: Fruit Dip
_similar.description: A simple and flavorful cream cheese dip infused with orange juice and marshmallow creme, ideal for fresh fruit.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients in a dish and beat until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with fresh cut-up fruit.

_similar.keywords: fruit dip, orange cream cheese, marshmallow dip

_similar.name: Veggie Pizza
_similar.description: A simple and customizable veggie pizza using crescent rolls as the crust, topped with a cream cheese mixture and various vegetables.
recipeIngredient: Veggies (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, celery, red or green peppers, green onions)

recipeInstructions.text: Roll out crescent rolls on a cookie sheet and a small cake pan. Bake until golden brown. Cool.
Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, cream cheese, and ranch dressing to make the cream mixture.
Spread cream mixture on cooled rolls.
Top with finely chopped vegetables of your choice.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Chill and cut into small pieces. Serve as hors d'oeuvres.

_similar.name: Stuffed Mushrooms
_similar.description: A savory appetizer of mushroom caps filled with a creamy mixture of bacon, cream cheese, and Parmesan.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the crumbled bacon, cream cheese, Parmesan cheese, and Worcestershire sauce together.
Stuff the mixture into the mushroom caps.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: stuffed mushrooms, appetizer, bacon, cream cheese
